protocol.previous_goal_turn: progress: V2 full Native/JIT pass, OFF fails confirmed title100k and Dijkstra; full validation passes. A/A diagonal controls distinguish stable old/new Dijkstra performance; profiling attributes the difference to unchanged hot-array cache comparison loop. V2 remains rejected-full; original deadline missed.
protocol.specific: Remove redundant string-byte resolution in generated Native typed array reads, and keep checked string-array reads plus string equality in SLJIT machine-code segments. Retained immutable byte views must validate complete reference identity, execution/function/layout, GC epoch and overwrite boundaries. Cold reference VM stays independent. Extend the same Native proof to bytes of a just-successfully-published string constructor, avoiding revalidation of that known new string in formatting/concatenation/text creation. No JIT implementation change relative to v1.
protocol.evidence: build/title-phase-diagnosis/selection.json Native100k setup creates300016 managed strings; v1 optimized container reads but leaves checked access immediately after successful constructors. This is a separate redundant check site justified by constructor postconditions.
protocol.early_gate: Original title pair, 3 warmups and 11 paired alternating fresh-process samples per engine. Native pair geometric latency reduction >=15%, VM >=20%; each title row >=5% reduction. Targets Native >=30%, VM >=40%; target misses disclosed. No diagnostic binary timed for acceptance.
protocol.full_gate: All32 original correctness and full paired Native/ON timing; each engine sum of medians must not regress >1%. Any row median or P90 regression >5% requires exactly one confirmation; confirmed >5% blocks acceptance. Smaller positive changes disclosed. OFF immutable object-reuse proof or full paired timing. Fresh fiveway table after acceptance.
protocol.validation: Full ON/OFF CTest on fresh validation builds, focused ASan+UBSan and x86 Rosetta tests and all32 correctness. Exact finite/shared/SIZE_MAX fuel, checked/proven bounds, unchanged failure destination, stale/wrong-heap/wrong-kind references, rooted GC and cold overwrites, empty/NUL/Unicode bytes, all reachable allocation-failure indices and both zero ledgers. Six architecture/memory/document/generated gates before main commit/push. LinuxLSan/fullTier1/physicalx86 performance remain open.
protocol.host_gate: Three quiet snapshots 10s apart, monitor every5s; known foreign compiler/test/profiler/Node/Python >=40% CPU outside owned benchmark descendants invalidates timing. No builds/tests/profiles while timing. Preserve all failures/observations and frozen controls. V2 host audit found monitor gaps up to820s. V3 additionally rejects any sampling gap >15s; a completed performance rejection is never replaced by a host replay.
protocol.limits: Original64MiB, arguments,stdout unchanged. No production changes or peer tuning.
protocol.unresolved: Original source-run preparation remains ~40ms plus JIT ~4ms in title diagnostics; search improvement alone cannot reach end-to-end title10k parity. D055 budget-preflight and F32 descriptor baseline defects remain open. No language semantics or runtime limits changed. Existing B0001 lowering defect for direct string-returning call on indexed-assignment RHS retained at minimize-fixture/minimized.my; equivalent named temporary works on control and candidate.
protocol.additional_hypothesis: Extend D104 nonallocating regions to checked string-array reads and byte equality. A bounded two-entry string-view cache remains local to one region, cannot survive any call/allocation/GC/cold exit, compares full reference identity and never publishes a failed read. Remove two of three repeated string validations within scan iterations, retaining independent ordinary dispatch and exact fuel. This addresses the original title-family OFF path as well as JIT/Native.
protocol.repair_gate: Original OFF title100k and Dijkstra, 3 warmups/11 alternating pairs. Each median/P90 <=1.05 against immutable accepted control; OFF title100k target >=20% reduction. One run; failure rejects repair. Then the unchanged Native/JIT early and all32 full gates apply.

validation_counts.explanation: New standalone mmay_vm_hot_strings test is required in every build, in addition to V2 coverage.
